conviction_note: Peer prints from 2026-10-13 (JPM equities +49% y/y and above the Zacks line, GS equities +72%, IB +14-21% y/y) imply MS lands above a bar that sits ~3% under Q2 and well under Q2 on the equity line, so the fundamental read is a beat (print_vs_bar +2.6% on revenue); but the same session sold those beats (GS from +4.1% high to +0.2%, JPM from +3.0% to +0.4%, MS itself from +1.2% to -1.3%) and MS's own 43% equity beat in July bought +0.39%, so p_up is only 55 on an abs move of 4.4 (above the 3.83 implied, toward the 4.62 median reaction); the findings sum (+0.45) and the scaled number (+0.44) agree in sign and size.

positioning_check: Short interest: latest found 14.6M shares at the 2026-04-30 settlement, 2.77 days to cover on 5.3M ADV (~0.9% of shares), https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/ms/short-interest ; September 2026 settlements not retrievable (Nasdaq API 503). Not a crowded short. Baseline skew_25d -2.88 vol points (calls richer than puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.46, straddle 4.07% / event-implied 3.83%. Tape: -8.92% over 20 sessions, -17.79% from 52w high, and -1.27% intraday 2026-10-13 at 13:22 ET (opened 192.22, high 193.24, 187.61) while XLF ~-0.1% and SPY flat. Sell-side sentiment soft: Citi PT cut $235->$210 (2026-09-30), Wells PT $240->$223 (2026-09-25).

findings.finding: Peer equity trading printed far above MS's equity line consensus: JPM Equity Markets $5.0B, +49% y/y, led by Prime and Derivatives (vs Zacks consensus ~$4.5B, an ~11% beat), GS Equities $6.44B, +72% y/y with financing +96% y/y and +3% q/q (both -13% to -17% q/q from record Q2). Applying the peers' q/q decline to MS's record Q2 equity $6.3B gives ~$5.2-5.5B (y/y method gives $6.1-7.1B off Q3'25 $4.12B), against a Zacks equity consensus of $4.51B (+9.6% y/y): a ~$0.7-1.0B line beat, roughly +$0.30-0.40 EPS before comp; headline consensus of $20.66B / $3.12 likely embeds some of this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: equity trading $6.3B vs ~$4.4B StreetAccount consensus (+43%), revenue $21.35B vs $19.28B, EPS $3.46 vs $2.81; stock +0.39% (baseline; https://qz.com/morgan-stanley-record-revenue-profit-stock-trading-071526). Q3 2025: equity $4.12B vs Zacks $3.22B, revenue $18.22B vs $16.45B; stock +4.71% (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Peers reported this morning, after every MS estimate was set; the Zacks MS equity line ($4.51B, dated 2026-10-09) sits 28% below MS's own Q2 print, and MS's own sell-side has not had time to revise. If priced, MS would have held the +1.2% opening gap on the GS/JPM equity beats rather than closing -1.3%.

findings.finding: Peer investment banking grew double digits y/y in Q3: GS IB fees $3.22B +21% y/y (advisory $1.65B +18% y/y and +20% q/q, equity UW +43% y/y but -32% q/q), JPM IB fees $3.0B +14% y/y on advisory; MS consensus (Zacks) IB $2.27B is flat y/y vs Q3'25 $2.108B with total underwriting -6.3%. Peer rates imply MS IB ~$2.4-2.5B, a ~$150-250M beat on a line mgmt called 'very robust' with a record 100+ PE sell-side mandate pipeline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 IB $2.4B +58% y/y inside a beat that bought +0.39%; no clean line-specific reaction available.
findings.why_not_priced: The Zacks MS IB line (dated 2026-10-09) assumes zero growth while both peers that printed today grew 14-21%; nothing MS-specific has updated since.

findings.why_not_priced: MS's FICC line consensus already assumes a decline, so the gap is small; filed because JPM's FICC miss vs consensus shows street line estimates ran high this quarter.

findings.finding: The market sold the peer beats on 2026-10-13: GS ($17.01 EPS vs ~$13.50 expected, revenue $18.68B vs $16.4B) opened 923 (+3.2%), hit 930.88 (+4.1%) and traded 895.66 (+0.2%) at 13:21 ET; JPM opened +1.7%, high +3.0%, then +0.4%; MS opened 192.22 (+1.2%) and traded 187.61 (-1.27%) at 13:22 ET while XLF was -0.1% and SPY flat. Read-through: 'peak trading quarter' beats are being faded, the same pattern as MS's July record quarter (+0.39%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MS Q2 2026 record quarter, 11% revenue beat: +0.39% (baseline). Prior three prints +4.5% to +5.8% (baseline), so the damped response is recent, not structural.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced already: MS's own -1.3% today is the market pre-selling the same fear. Filed because the fade is the freshest direct evidence of the sector's reaction function, and the skew (-2.88, calls bid) and put/call OI 0.46 still show options positioned for upside, i.e. the options market has not adopted it.

findings.finding: Wealth flows stayed strong into Q3: co-president Simkowitz said on 2026-09-15 that 'the flow of capital out of the SpaceX complex in this quarter is still really, really strong' and employee flows to advisors 'keeps going up, even in this quarter'; Schwab's August core net new assets were a record $64.8B (+46% y/y); JPM AWM client asset net inflows were $263B in Q3. Against MS Q3'25 NNA of $81B (Q2'26 record $148B, over half stock-plan IPOs), a Q3 NNA well above $81B is likely; no consensus NNA found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 record NNA $148B inside the +0.39% reaction; NNA is a multiple driver for the wealth franchise but has not been isolated in a reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Management said it publicly a month ago, so the direction is known; the size is not, and previews (Hudson Labs) still frame IPO-driven flows as 'ebb and flow'. Small because mgmt already told the market.

findings.finding: Retail trading activity cooled through Q3 vs Q2, a headwind for E*TRADE transactional revenue: Schwab daily average trades 11.6M in July and 9.8M in August vs a record 11.8M in May; Robinhood equity notional $267B for Sept 1-24 (~$14.8B/day over 18 sessions) vs $16.0B/day in August.

findings.finding: Q3 is the first quarter under the new $20B multiyear buyback authorization (Q2 repurchases $1.5B, CET1 14.8% with 300-350 bp excess); GS repurchased $3.0B in Q3. A step-up in MS's Q3 buyback pace is likely and visible in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The $20B authorization itself was announced with the Q2 print (+0.39%).
findings.why_not_priced: The authorization is known; the Q3 pace is not. Small.

findings.why_not_priced: Agrees with the skew (calls bid), so partly in the price; filed small because the causes are sentiment items the print can address, not earnings misses.

baseline_tension: The fundamental read (peer equities and IB beats, stale MS line estimates) agrees with the call-side skew (-2.88) and cuts against the 20-day -8.9% drawdown, but today's sector-wide fade of beats, including MS's own -1.3%, cuts against both and holds p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 and 6: equity-line finding cut from +1.2 to +0.8 because MS's last 43% equity beat bought +0.39% and the equity-line consensus is single-source (Zacks); kept positive because 'a peer's print landing after the company last spoke, leaving consensus stale' is the pattern the file says has paid.

Lesson 7: the fade/positioning negative cut from -1.2 to -0.9 because it runs against the call skew (-2.88) and short interest is not crowded (~0.9%, 2.8 days), but not removed because it is today's direct evidence.
Lesson 6 (inside guidance): wealth-flows finding cut from +0.4 to +0.3 because mgmt already told the market Q3 SpaceX flows were strong.
Lesson 5: drawdown finding cut from +0.4 to +0.3; the drawdown has named causes, so it is not worth zero, but it agrees with the skew.
